The '''smithing upgrade template''' (in-game name ''Smithing Template'', described as "Smithing Upgrade Template") replaces the netherite upgrade. It is needed to upgrade [[mattock]]s, [[dolabra]]s and [[claymore]]s, and for the vanilla adamant horse and nautilus armor recipes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_mattock.json}}</ref> The [[Silver Sword|silver sword]] and [[Warding Shield|warding shield]] take [[silver bullion]] in the template slot instead.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/silver_sword.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==
Crafted from 7 iron ingots, a [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]] and a deepslate, cobbled deepslate or blackstone block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/smithing_template.json}}</ref> Obtaining it grants ''Upgrades''.
